basics.name: Valentin Radulescu
basics.label: Front-End Engineer | React, TypeScript & React Native
basics.summary: Front-end engineer with 9 years of experience building user interfaces and the systems that support them. Developed Skype's messaging interface with React Native and helped build Hootsuite Analytics from the ground up with React. Took a career break from 2022 to 2025 while pursuing a BSc in Computer Science. Now seeking for exciting work opportunities, open to in-office, relocation, and remote.
